_comment: slug -> YouTube ID. convert-to-markdown.js injects the embed at the top of the matching page in data/markdown/. NOTE: that output only reaches the site via ingest-new.js, which skips any slug that already has a published page — so these entries affect NEW articles only. To add a video to a page already in docs/, edit that .mdx directly. Set an entry to null or delete it to remove the video.
